input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Deepen (flagship 7) photo-editing: browser cull page develops DNGs with no embedded JPEG (phone DNGs) from their sensor data
errors: My first in-page worker pool spliced one queued job from every worker's queue but ran only the first, so the card stuck at 'Reading 12 of 13' in Chromium; rewritten around one shared queue, with an onerror that fails queued jobs instead of hanging.
First previews: 3 of 32 came out magenta (CFA phase counted from the DefaultCrop corner rather than ActiveArea; white balance pushing clipped highlights pink); both fixed and pinned by unit tests.

doc_friction.issue: --replace parked the row's whole trailing 'next' list (Nikon AF grids, real card, Lightroom read) to NEXT.md to make room for a 110-character edit; I had to put the next items back with a second edit.
Playwright is only global here; eval scripts load it via createRequire with NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g), which nothing in the venture README says.

deviations.why: Start here's numbered items for photo-editing were noise-research sweeps that earlier runs judged spent; I took the user-facing gap the cull page's own docs listed (phone DNGs with no preview) instead.
deviations.did: Built an in-browser DNG mosaic decoder and preview developer for the cull page.
deviations.result: Landed; 26 of 26 phone DNGs that used to show nothing now have previews.

notes: Checks: node --test site/rawmosaic.test.mjs (11 pass; 56 with the other site tests). Sensels equal shootflow raw_develop.read_raw on 32 of 32 public DNGs (26 HDR+ bursts from storage.googleapis.com/hdrplusdata + 6 metadata-extractor DNGs). Colour median 0.41 dE vs shootflow dcraw-model half develop, 0.68 vs DNG model; worst 3.28 (Leica T WarpRectilinear, not run). Chromium: 26 HDR+ DNGs 529 MB in 10.8 s, 26/26 previews, no page errors. Agent doc: the eval note serves; no separate docs/reports entry needed.
